title: temperature_from_c is not the inverse of normalize_temperature_c: every Fahrenheit set-point write is wrong
claim: inputs.temperature_from_c(c, unit) multiplies by the unit's to-Celsius factor instead of dividing by it, so for the three Fahrenheit spellings a value written and read back through normalize_temperature_c is not the value written: 21.5 degC is written as 43.94 degF (6.6 degC) instead of 70.7 degF.
mechanism: const.TEMPERATURE_UNIT_TO_C holds (offset, factor) with degC = (value + offset) * factor. The forward rule (inputs.py:normalize_temperature_c) applies it; the backward rule (inputs.py:temperature_from_c) returns value_c * factor - offset where the inverse is value_c / factor - offset. Factor is 1.0 for degC and K, so only the 5/9 rows disagree. Callers: SetpointGrid.quantise (inputs.py:643-647), write_setpoint_c (inputs.py:770) and setpoint_check's Fix value (setpoint_check.py:183): every set-point the integration writes to an entity whose unit is degF.

evidence.unit: probes of 35 on which write-then-read differs (4 temperatures x 3 Fahrenheit spellings; 0 degC and the 4 Celsius/Kelvin spellings agree)
evidence.machine: Apple M1 (8 cores), Darwin 27.2.0 arm64, Python 3.14.7 (venv-ci)
evidence.contention_note: shared box during the fan-out, load1 150-270; the number is a static or behavioural count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: attribute swap of inputs.temperature_from_c for `value_c / factor - offset` (m8_agree.py --only temperature_roundtrip --perturb)

metric_definition: probes (unit, degC) with normalize_temperature_c(temperature_from_c(c, unit), unit) != c, over every unit of TEMPERATURE_UNIT_TO_C x 5 temperatures
phenomenon_property: For every unit row u of a unit table and every value v in the model's unit, to_model(from_model(v, u), u) == v: a conversion written forwards and backwards is one rule, and the backward form is derived from the forward one (or tested against it) rather than written again.

null_control.note: the other forward/backward pair of the package (DhwStore.store_temp_for_tap / tap_temp_for_store) round-trips on 24 of 24 probes; the Celsius and Kelvin rows of the same table round-trip on 20 of 20

proposed_fix_scope: inputs.py:temperature_from_c divides by the factor; a round-trip check over every row of TEMPERATURE_UNIT_TO_C in the suite. One owner: inputs.py (the table's only reader pair).
